{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check for the sentinel value in customer_age
print(f"Number of -1 values in customer_age: {df[df['customer_age'] == -1].shape[0]}")

# Check revenue format
print(f"Unique revenue values (first 10): {df['revenue'].unique()[:10]}")

# Check for QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
qa_orders = df[df['revenue'] == '999999.99']
print(f"Number of QA orders: {len(qa_orders)}")

# Check for refunded orders
refunded = df[df['status'] == 'refunded']
print(f"Number of refunded orders: {len(refunded)}")

# Check if there are any NEW customers reached by PAID SEARCH
new_paid_search = df[(df['customer_segment'] == 'new') & (df['channel'] == 'paid_search')]
print(f"Number of NEW customers reached by PAID SEARCH: {len(new_paid_search)}")

# Check what 'converted' values are
print(f"Unique values in 'converted': {df['converted'].unique()}")"}
